mapper.insert: INSERT INTO solution (user_id, title, content, problem_source, problem_id, tags, status, favorite_count, view_count, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{problemSource}, #{problemId}, #{tags}, #{status}, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE solution SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, problem_source = #{problemSource}, problem_id = #{problemId}, tags = #{tags}, status = #{status}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE solution SET deleted = 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE solution SET status = 2, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, problem_source, problem_id, tags, status, favorite_count, view_count, created_time, updated_time, deleted FROM solution WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, s.title, s.content, s.problem_source AS problemSource, s.problem_id AS problemId, s.tags, s.status, s.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, s.view_count AS viewCount, s.created_time AS createdTime, CASE WHEN f.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS favorited FROM solution s INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN solution_favorite f ON f.solution_id = s.id AND f.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.sql:

mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, s.title, s.problem_source AS problemSource, s.problem_id AS problemId, s.tags, s.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, s.view_count AS viewCount, s.created_time AS createdTime, FALSE AS favorited
ORDER BY s.created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, s.title, s.problem_source AS problemSource, s.problem_id AS problemId, s.tags, s.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, s.view_count AS viewCount, s.created_time AS createdTime, TRUE AS favorited FROM solution_favorite f INNER JOIN solution s ON s.id = f.solution_id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM solution_favorite f INNER JOIN solution s ON s.id = f.solution_id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE solution SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE solution SET favorite_count = GREATEST(0, favorite_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, s.title, s.problem_source AS problemSource, s.problem_id AS problemId, s.tags, s.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, s.view_count AS viewCount, s.created_time AS createdTime, FALSE AS favorited FROM solution s INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY s.created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM solution s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tags SEPARATOR ',') FROM solution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != ''
SELECT tags FROM solution WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != ''
SELECT id, tags FROM solution WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != ''
